test_inference: test the HunyuanDiTPAGPipeline inference by running a text-to-image generation and verifying output shape and pixel values
test_pag_disable_enable: test that PAG pipeline produces identical output to the base pipeline when pag_scale is set to zero
test_pag_applied_layers: test the PAG attention processor layer selection using regex patterns to target specific transformer blocks
test_fused_qkv_projections: test that fusing and unfusing QKV projections in the transformer does not change pipeline output values
test_save_load_optional_components: test saving and loading a PAG pipeline with optional components set to None and verify outputs match
